Messages.Author: marco
Messages.Body:
This is the combat

Arika vs Lazverinuts

Range : short

Arika do 3 damage to Lazve
Lazve do 5 damage to Arika

Arika prevent 2 damage
Lazve prevent all

then Lazve play an pulled fangs on Arika
but arika wants to play two additional strikes.

Question:
Arika must go in to torpor or first can play addizzional strikes?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Pulled Fangs has received errata: the damage it inflicts is no longer
aggravated.

But, even if it were, it cannot be played until the press step, which
is after all the additional strikes have been gained and resolved.
